summary: Implement local-rebase Branch-Update Strategy in PR Babysit (Issue #260 / Epic beta-roadmap)

entries.migration_impact: Users of `gh plate pr babysit --branch-update-strategy local-rebase --act` now get automatic local worktree rebase + push instead of NotImplementedError. Safe (isolated worktree, force-with-lease push, cleanup). Report includes local_rebase_* fields. AGENTS.md and CLI help already documented the option; now functional.
entries.agent_notes: Prefer --branch-update-strategy local-rebase when you want fully local, auditable rebase without @copilot comment (e.g. trusted local env or airgapped). Falls back gracefully on conflicts (sets local_rebase_conflict=True). Use with --act. Complements copilot-request (posts @copilot) and none.
